description: Survey-level read of the repo claude was launched in. Captures the SHAPE of the codebase (paths, file-type histogram, manifest presence, framework hints) without committing to mechanism. Bounded: no deep file read. This is the SENSE seam of the onboard-v0 standard — the first signal the recursive onboarding pipeline produces ON the user.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the repo claude was launched in.

files_by_ext_count.description: Histogram of file extensions to file counts. E.g., { 'ts': 42, 'json': 7 }.

frameworks_detected.description: Coarse framework/runtime hints: 'node', 'vitest', 'next', 'rust-cargo', 'python-pyproject', etc. Best-effort, no false confidence.
